messages:
mike_release: Heads up—I'm drafting the internal release note for 0.9.3. Planning a staged pin at 10:00 PT tomorrow. Need oncall coverage and a rollback line we can paste into the ops channel.

andrea_pm: Thanks Mike. Audience is internal staff + SRE + customer success. Keep the first paragraph short (2 lines). Will stakeholders need a separate note?

mike_release: No external blast for this patch. We'll ping CS if anything user-visible comes up. For the internal blurb: short highlight + risk + rollback pointer.

sara_prod: Adding the small perf change note: 'improved KV cache reuse for short sequences, ~7% token cost reduction' — should that be in the highlights?

mike_release: Yes. Put that first line. Also call out model pin: pinned rdx-llama-7b-v2 -> rdx-llama-7b-v3 (quantized) on hosted only for canary.

toni_oncall: I can be oncall 10:00–12:00 PT. Rollback criteria: token error rate >1% OR median p95 latency increase >200ms compared to baseline for 5 minutes. If hit, rollback to rdx-llama-7b-v2 and disable the quantization flag.

andrea_pm: Can we have a short command to run? ops likes copy-paste-ready commands.

mike_release: Suggested rollback snippet for ops:
```
# rollback to pinned version
redwoodctl rollout set --service=hosted-generation --model=rdx-llama-7b-v2 --reason="rollback perf regression"
```

toni_oncall: LGTM. Also add a note to check `token_cost_per_minute` dashboard and the `kv_cache_hit_ratio` for regressions.

eli_docs: Draft internal announcement block (suggested):
"""
Heads up: Deploying release 0.9.3 (canary) — pinned model rdx-llama-7b-v3 (quantized)
Highlights: improved KV cache reuse for short sequences (~7% token cost reduction).
Change window: 10:00–10:30 PT (canary), expand if stable.
Risk: quantization-related latency regressions; monitoring and automatic rollback criteria in place.
Rollback: `redwoodctl rollout set --service=hosted-generation --model=rdx-llama-7b-v2`
Oncall: @toni_oncall during 10:00–12:00 PT.
Please report any anomalies in #eng-oncall and ping @mike_release.
"""

andrea_pm: Nice — can we trim the highlights line to one sentence? Otherwise ready.

mike_release: Edited copy below. I'll paste into #eng-releases 15m before canary and into #ops-deploybot when deploy-bot posts. @deploy-bot can you queue the canary rollout for 2026-03-27T17:00Z?

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by mike_release. id=deploy-1769804444-1, target=hosted-generation, model=rdx-llama-7b-v3, mode=canary, window=2026-03-27T17:00Z->2026-03-27T17:30Z. To cancel: `deploy-bot cancel deploy-1769804444-1`.

sara_prod: Quick check — does this touch Dedicated customers? If so, we should include a notice.

mike_release: No Dedicated changes. Hosted-only canary. I'll mention that explicitly in the blurb.

toni_oncall: I'll be watching dashboards at 10:00 PT. If I see the rollback threshold, I'll trigger the `redwoodctl` rollback and post summary in this thread.

andrea_pm: (reaction :thumbsup:) thanks all — please save a final copy of the announcement in the RN doc and mark it 'internal-ready'.

eli_docs: Saving final copy to the RN doc now and will attach the short snippet to the release notes. File: https://docs.internal.redwood/rn/0.9.3-internal

mike_release: Perfect. I'll post the internal announce 15m before the window. Thread closed unless blockers appear.
